Build a stronger back in just 15 minutes with this military-style bodyweight back workout you can do anywhere — no gym, no weights, and no equipment required.
We’ll work for 40 seconds and rest for 20 seconds. The goal isn’t to rush through reps. Control each movement, create tension, and focus on squeezing the working muscles to get as much as possible out of every exercise.
WORKOUT
BODYWEIGHT BACK
• Prone Lat Pulldowns
• Superman Pulldowns
• Alternating Prone Rows
• Prone T Raises
